workload: Explain in three short sentences why duplicate sensor events can distort a rolling vibration average.
Explain in three short sentences why an industrial pump can have a high vibration reading without a confirmed failure.
Explain in three short sentences why a prediction score must identify the model and feature timestamp.

warmup.text: Duplicate sensor events can distort a rolling vibration average because they introduce noise and redundancy into the data, which can obscure the true vibration patterns and trends.

An industrial pump can have a high vibration reading without a confirmed failure due to various factors such as misalignment, improper installation, or the presence of contaminants that can cause increased friction and noise.

A prediction score must identify the model and feature timestamp because it allows for tracking the performance of the model over time and understanding the impact of changes in the data or model parameters. This is crucial for maintaining the accuracy and reliability of the model predictions.
